column1: # BaF+ - He TRACER-EFFECTIVE cross section sigma_t(E_cm) for ParticleTracing3D.jl (--sigma-model table,
# pass with --sigma-table and -m 4.002602). Same construction as bafplus_ne_sigma_tracer.tsv: the tracer draws
# collisions at n*sigma*v_coll with a flux-weighted Maxwellian partner and isotropic CM scattering, so
#     sigma_t(V) = <Q1(g) g g_par> <g> / (v_coll <g g_par>),  averages over the He Maxwellian,
# tabulated vs E_cm = mu*v_coll^2/2, v_coll = sqrt(8kT/(pi m_He) + V^2). Equals Q1 for fast ions and the
# Chapman-Enskog thermal value at rest. Rows with E_cm < 5.36 K: exact V=0 limit for local T = 0.3-4 K;
# rows above: computed at T = 4 K. Q1 from tracer/data/bafplus_he_q1.tsv (tools/cross_section/ion_he.py).
